svg.title: From Offer Page to Hidden Spread
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-pay-per-call-spread-workflow; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: From Offer Page to Hidden Spread; subtitle: The five-step pay-per-call lane check practitioners run before buying traffic; caption: A buyer pays a fixed price for a live inbound call that clears pre-agreed rules on duration, geography and hours; the operator keeps the spread between traffic cost and call price.; assumptions note: Figures are attributed practitioner claims: TrackDrive's $50 revenue, $35 payout, $15 margin split; Ringba's $25 call costing $2 to generate; Leadbase's three-of-ten paid ratio turning a $50 cost into $150. Results vary by vertical and buyer.; note: Sources: WordsAtScale (DJFaYJ3O7aU), Ringba (4kaOQgGnpJo), Leadbase (ewNftdwX784), TrackDrive (V1FTIO7peWA, _h1_mcKPGjY), Start & Grow Your Business (8qGNYXEyrqI).; stages: step: 01; label: Read every line of the offer page; value: Step 1; detail: Check minimum call length, buyer hours, hold period, and who owns the buyer before sending a single call (WordsAtScale).; step: 02; label: Front the network number with your own tracking; value: Step 2; detail: Put your own tracking number in front of the network's number to verify every call and catch skimming (Ringba).; step: 03; label: Model the worst-case paid ratio; value: Step 3; detail: A buyer paying for three of ten calls turns a $50 cost into $150 per paid call (Leadbase).; step: 04; label: Qualify each call on duration rules; value: Step 4; detail: A call that meets the rules is qualified and paid; one that does not is unpaid. Callers stay on the line a minute or two (TrackDrive; Start & Grow).; step: 05; label: Pocket the spread and keep it hidden; value: Step 5; detail: $50 revenue minus $35 payout leaves $15 per call; once a campaign works, never let the buyer see a $25 call that cost $2 (TrackDrive; Ringba).
